parsed.explanation: Estimate (7) is the write-up's entire necessity mechanism (the O((y-t)^2) local bound giving constant displacement), yet it is only asserted: 'Squaring the lower and the upper inequality, rearranging, and using b,c>=0 (standard; details omitted)'. The objection is locally right: the correct derivation uses only the AM-GM (right-hand) inequality at (x,y)=(f(t),t... ), giving (t+y+2c)^2 >= 4(t+c)(y+b), i.e. (t-y)^2 >= 4(t+c)(b-c), so d(y)-d(t) <= (y-t)^2/(4t); the min{t,y} denominator arises only after swapping t and y, a step never mentioned, and b,c>=0 is not used. No such computation appears anywhere in the text, so (7) is unproved as written; inserting the two-line derivation plus the swap repairs it.
